```{r}
#install.packages(pkgs = c("tidyverse","SmartEDA","plyr","knitr","flextable", "gtsummary"))

# Libraries & Imports
packages <- c("tidyverse","SmartEDA","plyr","knitr","flextable","gtsummary")
invisible(lapply(X = packages, FUN = library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Load BAF Data
baf <- read.csv("Base.csv")

baf_subset <- baf[, c("fraud_bool", "income", "customer_age", "credit_risk_score", "name_email_similarity", "proposed_credit_limit", "session_length_in_minutes", "payment_type", "housing_status", "employment_status", "device_os")]
```

```{r}
# Continuous Variables
ExpNumStat(baf_subset, by="A", round= 2) %>%
  flextable()

```
```{r}
#install.packages("dlookr")
# install.packages("moments")
library(dlookr)
library(moments)
library(dplyr)
library(officer)
```

```{r}
df_diag <- diagnose_numeric(baf_subset)

# Round all columns
df_diag[] <- lapply(df_diag, function(x) {
  if(is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x
})
```

```{r}

# Get diagnose_numeric output
df_diag <- diagnose_numeric(baf_subset)

# Function to safely compute stats on columns of baf_subset by name
extra_stats <- lapply(df_diag$variable, function(varname) {
  vec <- baf_subset[[varname]]
  
  # Calculate skewness, kurtosis, and IQR, handling NAs
  list(
    skewness = if (is.numeric(vec)) moments::skewness(vec, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
    kurtosis = if (is.numeric(vec)) moments::kurtosis(vec, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
  )
})

# Convert list of lists to data frame
extra_stats_df <- bind_rows(extra_stats)

# Combine with existing df_diag
df_diag_full <- bind_cols(df_diag, extra_stats_df)

# Round all numeric columns
df_diag_full[] <- lapply(df_diag_full, function(x) {
  if(is.numeric(x)) round(x, 2) else x
})

# Remove outlier column
df_diag_full <- df_diag_full %>%
  select(-outlier)

# Display as flextable
df_diag_full %>% 
  flextable() %>%
  set_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Notable Continuous Variables") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "header") %>%
  add_footer_lines("Note: fraud_bool is the target variable which is heavily skewed. Appoximately 99% of records belong to the negative class (Non-Fraud)") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = num_cols, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  border_inner_h(part = "body", border = fp_border(color = "gray", width = 0.5))

```

```{r}
# Categroical Variables
library(gtsummary)
library(cardx)

baf_subset %>%
  select(fraud_bool, payment_type, housing_status) %>%
  tbl_summary(by= fraud_bool) %>%
  modify_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Categorical Variables")

```

```{r}
baf_subset %>%
  select(fraud_bool, employment_status, device_os) %>%
  tbl_summary(by= fraud_bool)%>%
  modify_caption("Descriptive Statistics of Categorical Variables Continued")

```
